title: Anthropic’s AI Agents Started Trading in a Fake Economy | The Future of Agentic AI
description:
What happens when AI agents are allowed to interact, negotiate, and trade with each other in a simulated economy? 
Anthropic recently ran an experiment where autonomous AI agents operated inside a fake economy — making decisions, coordinating, and adapting on their own.
This is a glimpse into the future of Agentic AI, autonomous systems, and AI-powered digital economies. 🚀
If AI can already collaborate and trade today… imagine what’s coming next.
